visual_shift_summary: The design evolved from a stark minimalist black hero (2021) with raw typography into a sophisticated full-bleed layout with serif hierarchy, integrated product imagery, and progressive color sophistication (2026). The brand shifted from bold statement-making to outcome-focused credibility with polish and visual density increasing steadily.
